name: cost-meter
description: Always know what a session costs: live $ / context / rate-limit status line, the cost of every turn, context warnings, and an optional budget that asks before spending more.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Ask before spending more each time the session passes another multiple of this amount. 0 turns the budget off.

showTurnCost.title: Show each turn's cost
showTurnCost.description: Append the turn's cost to the line that closes it (Baked for 1m 3s · $0.12).

contextWarnings.title: Context warnings
contextWarnings.description: Toast when the context window passes 70%, 85% and 95%.
